5078-7902-8346.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Type-03 Borg Vessel.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library
Repeat

4681-5170-6797-8292.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

240-5470-5686-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2624-3249-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2624-3249-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, God-Eternal Oketra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2033-4687-5479.notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least three charge counters on it.
2033-4687-5479.description:
Activate Citanul Hierophants by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte two times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping two lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

757-1543-4221-5087.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-1543-4221-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Ichormoon Gauntlet to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Living Plane, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

3115-3557-4863.description:
Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1619-2034-4605-5542-6138.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6138.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Bloodboil Sorcerer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Bloodboil Sorcerer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6138.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-4184-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2511-4184-6972.notes: If Relentless Skaabs starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2167-6557-7380-7383.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Overgrown Tomb, adding {G}.
Activate Floral Evoker by paying {G} and discarding Veilborn Ghoul, returning Overgrown Tomb from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Overgrown Tomb enters, Floral Evoker and Veilborn Ghoul trigger.
Resolve the Floral Evoker trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Veilborn Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3713-5078-5741-6006.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1274-3490-5231-6720.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-5231-6720.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

997-1580-4871-5334.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

3921-4968-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Winding Constrictor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3921-4968-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

575-1872-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-1872-5971.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When Composite Golem dies, Yedora triggers, returning Composite Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Composite Golem enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers, turning Composite Golem face-up.
Repeat.

465-643-3742-4068-4251.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
465-643-3742-4068-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

4493-4779-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
You have enough mana to cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication
4493-4779-5365.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat from step 2.
4493-4779-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

618-2511-3991.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

5686-6103-6105.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, causing you to choose how players vote this turn and drawing a card.
Cast Magister of Worth by paying {4}{W}{B}.
When Magister of Worth enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Magister of Worth and any number of other creatures.
Resolve the Magister of Worth trigger, having each player vote for grace, returning all creatures from graveyards to the battlefield.
Resolve all abilities from step 4.
Repeat from 3.

654-4693-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
654-4693-5720-5721.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

568-3152-5570.notablePrerequisites:
Nardole has at least six counters on it.
Nardole does not have summoning sickness.
There is at least one other permanent on the battlefield.
568-3152-5570.description:
Activate Nardole by tapping it, adding at least six {U} that can only be spent to cast noncreature spells.
Cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Nardole.
Resolve Capsize, returning target permanent to its owner's hand and returning Capsize to your hand.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each of your turns.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-3259-5500.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-5500.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1013-1416-2178.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1013-1416-2178.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

777-2275-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1719-4056-4639.notablePrerequisites:
Second Wind attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
1719-4056-4639.description:
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Second Wind.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Second Wind.
Activate Second Wind's second ability by tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat.

95-5230.description: Declare Terisian Mindbreaker as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing an opponent to mill their library due to Bruvac.

1693-3750-3851-4813.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Famished Foragers.
Famished Foragers does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two opponents.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Famished Foragers.
 An opponent has lost life this turn.
1693-3750-3851-4813.description:
Declare Famished Foragers as an attacker.
Famished Foragers' myriad ability triggers, creating at least two token copies of it that are tapped and attacking.
The Famished Foragers tokens enter the battlefield, adding at least six {R}.
At the end of your combat phase, Blade of Selves triggers, exiling the Famished Foragers tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of red mana, if you have a card in hand, you may activate Famished Foragers' ability to rummage infinitely.

2026-3201-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Voyaging Satyr.
Arixmethes has at least one slumber counter on it.
2026-3201-4222.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Arixmethes.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.
